cases.name: EVOX Production LLC v. Midjourney, Inc.
Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. v. Midjourney, Inc.
Disney Enterprises, Inc. and Universal v. Midjourney, Inc.

profile_text.body:
Midjourney is a for-profit independent research lab founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species, with stated plans to release projects organized around themes of imagination, coordination, reflection, beauty, and human flourishing.

The company's primary AI product is Midjourney, an image generation tool categorized under image and graphic design, available at its main website.

Midjourney is a named defendant in several active copyright cases in federal court, including EVOX Production LLC v. Midjourney, Inc. and Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. v. Midjourney, Inc., both in the Central District of California, as well as Disney Enterprises, Inc. and Universal v. Midjourney, Inc., also in the Central District of California. The company is additionally a party in Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd., filed in the Northern District of California, which names multiple AI image generation companies.
